description:
Check on a project's video export, waiting for it to finish. Pass exactly one of `export_id` (the one export_project returned) or `project_id` (that project's most recently REQUESTED export, which may still be in progress). Returns { export_id, project_id, status, progress, requested_at, finished_at? }.

`status` is queued, waitlisted or pending (not started yet), inprogress (`progress` is 0-100), completed, failed, or stalled (stuck for hours; start a new export). The call holds open until the export completes, fails or stalls, or `wait_seconds` runs out — then it returns the current status and you call again with the returned export_id. An export takes ~5 min, so expect several calls.

With project_id, a project that has never been exported returns status `not_exported` straight away (nothing to wait on): call export_project(project_id), then get_export.

Once completed, the reply carries `download_url`: a direct, time-limited link (1 hour, see `expires_at`) that downloads the file named after the project, e.g. "Product tour.mp4" (`filename`). Calling get_export again mints a fresh link.

export_id.description: The export_id export_project returned. Omit when passing project_id.

project_id.description: Check this project's most recently requested export instead. Omit when passing export_id.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the export to complete or fail before answering, default 45s. Pass 0 for an immediate status check.

name: get_export
title: Get export status
